name: evalai-mcp
description: EvalAI (competitions): me, discover, get_competition, standings, enter. Every tool maps to a documen

platform_mcp_evalai_auth_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EVALAI_AUTH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_evalai_auth_token.description: EvalAI auth token from https://eval.ai/web/profile ('Get your Auth Token'; the token the evalai CLI uses). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

platform_mcp_evalai_participant_team_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_EVALAI_PARTICIPANT_TEAM_ID
platform_mcp_evalai_participant_team_id.description: Numeric id of your EvalAI participant team (from GET /api/participants/participant_team or the Participant Teams page); needed only by `enter`.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/auth/user/: pk, username, email, first_name, last_name.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: GET /api/challenges/challenge/{challenge_time}/{approved}/{published} with present/approved/public fixed: ongoing public challenges. The server pages (`page`, fixed size); `limit` is not sent and there is no text filter, so `query`, `kind` and `status` are not sent. short_description, is_registration_open and has_prize stay in `raw`.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: GET /api/challenges/challenge/{id}/. `description` and `submission_format` (submission_guidelines) are HTML; terms_and_conditions, evaluation_details and is_registration_open stay in `raw`. Phase splits (the leaderboard ids) are at GET /api/challenges/{challenge_pk}/challenge_phase_split (not mapped).

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Leaderboards are per challenge-phase split: pass the phase-split id (from /api/challenges/{challenge_pk}/challenge_phase_split) as `competition_id`, not the challenge id. Rows come in leaderboard order; `score` is the default-order metric (filtering_score) and the full metric vector is `raw.result` with labels in `raw.leaderboard__schema`.

tools.name: enter
tools.description: POST /api/challenges/challenge/{challenge_pk}/participant_team/{participant_team_pk}: registers your team (config `participant_team_id`) for the challenge; answers 201 with no body. Closed registration, email-domain rules and team-size limits come back as 406 errors.
